name: database
description: Experimental additive data requirements. Applicability depends on the selected task; no live database access is granted.

look-first.text: Where data is affected, establish the relevant schema, invariants and available fixture evidence. Preserve unknowns when no database or records are supplied.

planning.text: For applicable data changes, state ordering, compatibility, preservation requirements and recovery approach. Do not add migrations to work that does not require them.

implementation.text: Perform only the planned data actions in the authorized environment. Record the actual affected artifact or database and its result; a test fixture is not a production change.

verification.text: For affected data, execute checks for the declared invariants, intended change and preservation of unrelated records. Report the database or fixture identity used.
